notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign Soon
notes.content:
We're going to be running a 🚀 [b][url=https://thirstyheroes.com/ks]Kickstarter campaign[/url][/b] to grow the community and raise funds to finish development of Thirsty Heroes.  The campaign will launch in early February, but we've launched the "coming soon" page today, where you can click to be notified when the campaign launches.  That way you can be first in line for early bird rewards.

Rewards range from a simple copy of the game all the way to design rewards where you get to create monsters, quests, heroes, and drinks that will be included in the game.

Sign up to be notified on launch here: [url=https://thirstyheroes.com/ks]https://thirstyheroes.com/ks[/url], and please enjoy a special sneak preview of the Kickstarter trailer below:
[previewyoutube=ST6w9yTMEco;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: We are live!
notes.content:
Hello world! I'm Sean, designer and programmer at Bit By Bit Studios. We've been working quietly on Thirsty Heroes for several years and are really excited to show it off.

This game was designed to combine my love of management games with my obsession with loot dropping games like Diablo or Path of Exile. I wanted to have many heroes, manage my gear, and not have to rely on a wiki to be able to figure out what the best gear for my heroes was.  I wanted strategic turn-based combat instead of active combat so I could chill while I play, and I wanted my heroes to be able to crawl following my instructions, without me having to do everything manually.  I wanted there to be a fun and engaging story to make things more than a loot grind. The result is Thirsty Heroes, and I think a lot of players like me will enjoy it!

Follow along with development in our Discord here: https://discord.gg/tWs82tX
Or check out our dev log here: https://bxb.medium.com/

I'll also be posting updates here, of course! Thanks for your interest, cheers!

-Sean from BXB
